# Gupta's Evergreen Developers LLP — LLM Summary Index

> Premier turnkey residential construction company, licensed civil contractor, and architectural firm based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Specializing in anti-seismic RCC engineering (IS 1893 & IS 13920), MDDA building map sanctions, luxury hill villas, commercial complexes, and modular interiors.

**Full Unabridged Knowledge Base:** [https://www.guptasevergreendevelopers.com/llms-full.txt](https://www.guptasevergreendevelopers.com/llms-full.txt)

## Leadership & Designated Partners (E-E-A-T)
- **Sunil Kumar Gupta:** Founder & Designated Partner. Senior Civil Engineer with 20+ years hands-on experience in Doon Valley geotechnical evaluation, structural steel frameworks, machine-batched concrete casting, and public infrastructure works.
- **Vansh Gupta:** Designated Partner & Operations Director. Leads contemporary architectural integration, BIM 3D elevations, digital project tracking, acoustic thermal glazing, and bespoke luxury interior craftsmanship.

## Geographic Service Territory
- **Primary Market:** Dehradun, Uttarakhand (Rajpur Road, Sahastradhara Road, GMS Road, Canal Road, Vasant Vihar, Hathibarkala, Dalanwala, Jakhan, Clement Town, Raipur)
- **Extended Hill & Foothill Markets:** Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar, Chakrata, and adjoining Himalayan foothills in Uttarakhand.

## Construction Pricing & Turnkey Packages (2026 Rates)
- **Basic Essential Package:** ₹1,650 per sq.ft (Fe500 TMT steel, Ultratech cement, vitrified 2x2 tiles, 5-year warranty).
- **Premium Standard Package:** ₹1,950 per sq.ft (Most popular choice; Tata Tiscon Fe550D rebar, Kajaria tiles, Jaquar fittings, UPVC windows, 5-yr comprehensive + 10-yr structural warranty).
- **Luxury Turnkey Elite Package:** ₹2,450+ per sq.ft (Ultra-luxury finishes, Italian marble, bespoke modular kitchen with Blum hardware, smart home automation, 10-year guarantee).
- **Billing Model:** Transparent milestone-based escrow payments with strict 0% price escalation agreement.
- **Complimentary Offer:** Free on-site contour assessment and preliminary budget estimate within 24 hours across Dehradun.
